items.quote:
If any organization or nonprofit is aiding or supporting thugs attacking law enforcement officers, I will make it my personal mission to ensure the organization and its leaders are held accountable.

Not a threat. A promise.
items.promise: Said she would seek to hold accountable any organization or nonprofit found to be aiding people who attack law enforcement officers.

items.quote: Florida is home to 21 military installations and three combatant commands—it is imperative we keep our bases secure. That is why I will be fighting for the inclusion of my Drone Espionage Act in the NDAA.
items.promise: Said she would seek inclusion of her Drone Espionage Act in the NDAA.

items.quote: As Florida’s next U.S. Senator, I will work tirelessly to reduce the bloat of Washington and speak out loudly against government spending.
items.promise: Said she would work to reduce the size of the federal government and speak against government spending.

items.quote: I will fight this effort to destroy the CDC with everything I have as a member of the United States Senate.
This bill is a direct attack on the industry that is driving Georgia's economic development, job creation, and wealth creation in our state right now.
From this key position, I will strengthen U.S. national security and fight for Georgia’s veterans, servicemembers, and their families.
items.promise: Said that as ranking member of the Military Construction and Veterans Affairs appropriations subcommittee he would work on national security and veterans' issues.

items.quote:
I will not allow radical liberals in California to ban our bacon in Iowa!

Congress needs to strike down California's disastrous Prop 12 through my Food Security and Farm Protection Act to protect family farms and lower food costs

The FIND Act prevents the federal government from doing business with companies that discriminate against Americans exercising the 2nd Amendment.

I will not allow Washington to trample our Constitutional right to bear arms!

The SBIR program needs to be reformed to ensure cutting-edge innovation from small businesses gets into the hands of warfighters.

As @SmallBizCmteGOP chair, I will make this happen.
items.promise: Said that as Small Business Committee chair she would reform the SBIR program to get small-business innovation to the military.

items.quote: I cosponsored the SAVE America Act because showing identification to vote is plain common sense. The Senate must pass this bill and send it to the President’s desk.

Last week, Democrats voted against the Stop Insider Trading Act. This bill is vital to restore public confidence in Congress and keep our legislative process clean. I will continue to work to get this passed.
items.promise: Said he will continue working to pass the Stop Insider Trading Act.

items.quote: The Democrat shutdown has limited services on our public lands, stifling access to our great outdoors. I will continue to put Idaho and our public lands first, and vote for the clean funding bill that will reopen our government.

Bureaucratic loopholes within the ATF have wrongfully denied Idaho gun owners their constitutional right to own a firearm FOR YEARS. My bill, the ATF Transparency Act, slashes through the red tape and protects Americans Second Amendment rights.

I am an original cosponsor of the SAVE Act and proud to safeguard every Idahoan’s vote. We must keep American elections in American hands. I will continue to push for a vote on this important bill with @SenRickScott.
items.promise: Said he will continue pressing for a Senate vote on the SAVE Act.

items.quote: I will vote for the HALT Fentanyl Act, but this bill is only a starting point.
I will not vote to fund the illegal DHS and ICE operations that terrorize Chicago, Minneapolis, and many other communities.
items.promise: Said he will not vote to fund DHS and ICE operations he described as illegal.

items.quote:
The SAVE America Act would make it harder for millions of Americans, including married women, seniors, and veterans to vote.

That is an affront to our democracy, and I will be voting no.

I voted no on Markwayne Mullin’s nomination to be DHS Secretary.

I will not vote to install another yes-man to enable Donald Trump.

NEWS: Sen. Grassley and I will try to pass our bill today to crack down on drug ads. Big Pharma floods TV with deceptive Rx ads, but always keeps price secret. Our bill makes Pharma tell the price in the commercial. President Trump and Sec. Kennedy agree.

The decision of whether to run for re-election has not been easy. I truly love the job of being a United States Senator.

But in my heart, I know it’s time to pass the torch.

So, I am announcing today that I will not be seeking re-election at the end of my term.
I’ll always fight to protect hardworking Americans, support good-paying jobs, and ensure resources are available to train our next generation.
items.promise: Said she will continue to support workers, jobs and job-training resources.

items.quote: I will never stop fighting to keep Florida the freest state in the nation – a place built on economic freedom and safety in our communities.
items.promise: Said she will continue working to keep Florida, in her words, the freest state in the nation.

items.quote: I’ll keep fighting to cut the red tape and outdated regulations standing between our growers and their success.
items.promise: Said she will keep working to reduce regulations affecting Florida farmers.

items.quote: I am committed to fighting for policies that cut burdensome regulations, lower costs, and make homeownership achievable for every Florida family.
items.promise: Said she is committed to policies to reduce regulations and costs for home buyers.

items.quote: As your U.S. Senator, I will continue to prioritize policies that promote economic prosperity, cut taxes, and slash nonsensical government regulations.
items.promise: Said she will continue prioritizing tax cuts and reduced regulation.

items.quote: I will always have their backs as we work together to secure the border, end the fentanyl crisis, strengthen our national security, and protect Florida families.
items.promise: Said she will support law enforcement on border security and fentanyl.
